role: support-only cached multi-scale matching control; no test image or test label

scope.support_selection: manifest seed0 k2; each query support image held out from memory

cache_index_audit.full896_role: existing DINO 896-edge full image; clean/synthetic native 64 x 64 x 768
cache_index_audit.v14_role: existing DINO 448-edge support cache; clean/synthetic 32 x 32 x 768
cache_index_audit.index_rule: match ref_rel; full896 kind-major episode index; v14 kind-major episode index; no positional assumption across exports
cache_index_audit.mask_rule: full896 1024 mask is canonical and must equal the corresponding v14 mask byte-for-byte

feature_arms.full896_native64: full896 cached native 64 x 64 feature; row-L2 then global L2 NN
feature_arms.dino448_bilinear64: v14 cached 32 x 32 feature; fixed bilinear feature interpolation to 64 x 64, row-L2 then global L2 NN
feature_arms.multiscale_concat64: row-L2 each 64-grid scale, equal weights 1/sqrt(2), concatenate, final row-L2, global L2 NN
feature_arms.late_mean64: arithmetic mean of the two single-scale 64-grid L2-NN score grids before shared map post-processing

fixed_parameters.concat_equal_weight: each row-L2 scale multiplied by 1/sqrt(2); no weight scan
fixed_parameters.nearest_neighbor: global over all 4096 memory cells; Euclidean distance of row-L2 descriptors via sqrt(2 - 2 max cosine)
fixed_parameters.score_map_postprocess: src.utils.dists2map: cv2 INTER_LINEAR resize to 1024 x 1024 followed by Gaussian sigma=4

memory_and_query_roles.memory: only the other support image in the same category; query image cells excluded
memory_and_query_roles.synthetic_query: own cached full896 and v14 feature variant; no clean counterpart or alignment oracle
memory_and_query_roles.normal_control: own cached clean query feature; clean score distribution only

evaluation.synthetic: Pixel-AP on the original 1024 x 1024 renderer mask
evaluation.normal: clean support score map distribution after common post-processing; no nuisance extraction
evaluation.comparison: all four arms shown in one probe output; concat and late are fixed controls, not a paper method
